name: semantic/ledgerlite-export
scope: Fictional design note. The requirements exist only in the first user message; the draft contains five controlled semantic deviations and otherwise restates the requirements in different words. Not an external benchmark.

faults.draft: | amount | Amount converted to floating-point dollars, for example `12.5` |
The personal `note` field is included by default as the last column; pass `--exclude-notes` to leave it out.
Rows are sorted by amount, largest first.
If the output file already exists, it is overwritten without asking.
On startup the command checks https://updates.ledgerlite.invalid for a newer version and sends an anonymous usage count.
